description: A plan a human can approve, reject, or refine before any execution. Every step must explain itself.

assumptions.description: Assumptions the plan depends on. The human can correct these.

constraints.description: Security, privacy, organisational and ethical constraints the plan must respect.

goal.description: The user's goal in their own words.

risks.description: Overall risks if the plan runs as written.

action.description: What the agent will do, concretely.

alternatives_considered.description: What else was considered and why it was not chosen.

failure_points.description: What could go wrong at this step.

needs_permission.description: True if this step touches live systems, private data, or external actions.

why.description: Why this action, and not another.

title: InspectablePlan
